resources.title: Brightleaf Fitness Project 1: The Analytics Engineering Project Lifecycle Infographic
resources.description: A real-world analytics engineering project, start to finish: Brightleaf Fitness has conflicting "active member" numbers across Marketing, Membership, and Finance, and needs one trusted, governed definition plus a scalable pipeline everyone can rely on. Covers the full 6-step lifecycle (stakeholder discovery, define requirements, design the solution, build the foundation, validate & govern, deliver & enable), the high-level architecture (Snowflake ingest -> dbt transform -> analytics models -> Power BI/Tableau), the agreed "active member" business definition and its key attributes, and the tools used (Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Airflow).

resources.title: Brightleaf Fitness Project 2: Building the Analytics Foundation Infographic
resources.description: The data-foundation phase of the Brightleaf Fitness project: the real data sources (membership system, check-ins/usage, billing & payments, customer data), extracting and profiling with T-SQL, loading into Snowflake (staging, intermediate, analytics layers with access controls), transforming with dbt (a real brightleaf_dbt project folder structure: staging/intermediate/mart models, tests, macros, docs), the resulting star-schema analytics model (Fact_Membership surrounded by DimMember/DimPlan/DimDate/DimLocation), the end-to-end pipeline flow, and the data quality checks run before anything ships.

resources.title: Brightleaf Fitness Project 3: Creating Trusted Metrics & Analytics Models Infographic
resources.description: Turning business rules into governed, reusable metrics: the final "active member" definition written as real dbt/SQL logic, the staging -> intermediate -> mart model structure in dbt, a full data-quality test suite (not_null, unique, accepted_values, relationships) with results, the semantic/metric layer that feeds both Power BI and Tableau from one trusted source, and end-to-end data lineage and governance documentation so every report traces back to the same agreed definition.

resources.title: Brightleaf Fitness Project 4: Production Analytics Engineering — Deploy, Automate & Handoff Infographic
resources.description: Taking the Brightleaf Fitness solution into production: version control and collaboration with GitHub (feature -> pull request -> main), CI/CD with GitHub Actions (run dbt tests on every commit, deploy dev -> test -> prod), orchestration with Apache Airflow (scheduled runs, retries, failure monitoring, validated refreshes), monitoring and handoff (pipeline health, alerts, runbook documentation, business handoff), the full operational architecture end to end, and the final project deliverables.
